set.body:
Source: review of the 62-line testkit and duplicated scheduler stubs.

Problem:
users program against Scheduler[F], but suites hand-roll scheduler doubles. AttemptReplay is unused, ScriptedCommandExecutor ignores policy, and some test-to-compile dependencies are dead.

Acceptance:
- Provide deterministic scripted Scheduler[F] stubs/builders with submit, query, accounting, cancel, and log traces.
- Make command-executor test doubles honor their declared policy and surface exhaustion/mismatch as useful test failures.
- Remove or justify AttemptReplay and dead module dependencies.
- Migrate representative local, SSH, managed, and observability suites to the public testkit without reducing fault coverage.
set.title: P6f.19: Refocus the testkit on Scheduler programs
